faq.q: What is the best alternative to Calm and Headspace?
faq.a: It depends on why you're looking. For personalization, Balance assembles a session from your answers each day and Auserene writes a meditation from your day. For a free option, Insight Timer. For depth, Waking Up. For sleep, Calm itself is hard to beat.

Calm is stronger for sleep, with more than 500 Sleep Stories on its website and the widest device support. Headspace is stronger for learning to meditate and adds coaching, therapy through some plans and Ebb, its AI companion. Headspace costs $12.99 a month or $69.99 a year in the US as of November 2026.

faq.q: Is there a free alternative to Calm or Headspace?
faq.a: Insight Timer offers thousands of guided meditations for free, with an optional Premium plan for courses and offline listening. Calm says some of its programs are free forever. Auserene's free plan includes its free guided journeys and ambient sounds, while the meditation written from your day is Premium.

faq.q: Is there an AI meditation app that personalizes sessions?
faq.a: Yes, in different ways. Headspace's Ebb is an AI companion that recommends Headspace content. Endel generates soundscapes from your location and heart rate. Balance assembles sessions from your answers. Auserene uses AI to write a guided meditation from the conversation you had about your day.

faq.q: Does Headspace have an AI companion?
faq.a: Yes. Headspace's Ebb is an AI companion you can talk to by voice or text. It recommends meditations and activities and remembers past conversations. Headspace says it is available to paid members aged 18 and up in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, in English.

faq.q: What is a good meditation app with journaling?
faq.a: Stoic combines a full journal with generic guided and unguided meditation. Auserene is a journal that writes a guided meditation from each day's entry. Neither Calm nor Headspace lists a written journal.
